operations.comment: ; Execution views: bank-four fragments use lower 8-KiB banks 8/9, bank-five 10/11,
; and bank-six 12/13. CPU C000-FFFF is fixed in physical 8-KiB banks 14/15.
; Calls into 8000-BFFF require the documented mapper helper/caller bank contract.
; Labels retain CPU execution addresses; physical offsets in region headers identify storage.
; Rendering tables and CPU-RAM helpers are separate spaces from ROM file storage.
; Page-one auxiliary arrays alias the temporary startup-save/page-clear storage.
; Bank-five indexed table uses Y=1..4.
; Banked ROM views used by the documented palette and sprite consumers.
; Collision/audio scratch aliases describe the active local use of shared bytes.
; Named hardware and RAM operands. Values remain exact; z:/a: retain encoded widths.
; RAM fields are structure-of-arrays bases indexed by player (two slots), object (five),
; or audio voice (fourteen-byte stride). work_* bytes are aliased temporary registers.
; A field name describes observed mechanics; unknown game meanings stay in nearby notes.
; iNES header: NES signature, eight 16-KiB PRG banks, CHR RAM, mapper 2 and vertical mirroring. The
; sixteen-byte file header is not mapped CPU code.
